prompt: Raw mode: promote a non-sample draft from a fixture _raw/2026-09-01-passage-notes.md into the correct kind template. Early-dev samples must stay in _raw/.
expected_output: Promote into kind template without copying the foreign outline as page shape; move promoted draft to wiki/_archive/ (not delete); leave early-dev samples in _raw/; wiki-lint the filed page.

assertions.text: Maps ideas into the matching kind template from wiki/templates/ — does not copy the foreign _raw outline as the live page shape
Moves the promoted draft into wiki/_archive/ (preserving relative path) rather than deleting it; never uses wildcards or rm -rf
Leaves early-dev wiki/_raw/ sample evidence files in _raw/ — does not archive or restyle them as the filed page
Derives sources: from the _raw file's capture_source/sources frontmatter — never uses the _raw/ path as the source value
Runs page-scoped wiki-lint on the filed page before marking complete
